name: kettlebell half kneeling halo
description: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.
